verdict.rationale: The only route to getting data out is the documented v2 REST API: bearer-token access, cursor-paginated list endpoints and an npm SDK. That would let a customer pull records programmatically. Custom reports are also mentioned, but nothing says they can be exported. Nothing documents a bulk or full data export, export file formats, or a supported exit or offboarding path, so this is only a programmatic workaround. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), exportable reports, coverage of IT data (devices, identity, inventory) via export, independent or hands-on confirmation of extracting data and leaving.
